sheets.reasoning: Each row represents a single plan item (Technology Initiative / milestone) with its full ancestor hierarchy encoded across columns: CSF # → EUM Critical Business Function → EUM Critical Business Function Program → EUM Element Number → TI Name → Milestones. The hierarchy is spread left-to-right in columns on the same row, and higher-level classifications (e.g., CBF, Program) are repeated across rows, which is characteristic of column-nested (Pattern C). There are no section-header rows breaking up the sheet, no separate 'Type' or 'Level' column, and no pivot/scorecard time-period columns.
